V13_ISOLATION.enforcement: the source sha256 is captured before and after every build and asserted equal; a build that touched it raises rather than completing

SUCCESSOR_READINESS.why: as-of team form built on this lineage is form over OBSERVED CANONICAL GAMES, not over games actually played. For any slate after the first missing day the two differ, and a model trained on it learns a rate with the wrong denominator. A missing game is a scoring event that happened and is being averaged out.
SUCCESSOR_READINESS.blocked_by: outbound HTTPS 403 at the org egress proxy; not routed around. These dates need an owner-supplied official board or restored egress.
